core_idea: Lobotomy E.G.O::Faint Aroma & Solitude Ryōshū is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Bullet — Solitude** damage carry who applies **Tremor** on hits, spending ammo for burst on S1. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Tremor + Sinking) (max +2). Support passive (**Spring's Genesis**) buffs your **fastest Speed ally** — pair with a high-Speed attacker.
playstyle_guide:
- **Spring's Genesis** amplifies the **fastest Speed ally** — field a high-Speed damage dealer as teammate.
- **Burst** when you're ready to break the stagger target.
- Manage **Bullet — Solitude** — multiple skills spend limited ammo on coin flips. Preserve **Bullet — Solitude** for S1; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S2 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Tremor + Sinking) (max +2).

**S1 — Bang. Bang.** (BP 4, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 12 (High).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Tremor + Sinking)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Tremor + Sinking) on target (max 2)
- Spend 1 Bullet — Solitude; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Sinking Count

*↳ Alternate S1 — Stories that Never Cease* (BP 9, CP +1): rolls — low 9, high 12 (High).
  - Unfocused Volley
  - When this Skill inflicts Solitude, if the target has Solitude this turn, or will be inflicted with Solitude next turn, trigger Tremor Burst instead
  - then, reduce target's Tremor Count by 1

**S2 — Blossoming Fragrance in the Void** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Tremor + Sinking)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Tremor + Sinking) on target (max 2); [On Use] Deal +1% damage for every Faint Aroma on target
- Spend 1 Bullet — Solitude; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Sinking Count
- Inflict 3 Faint Aroma; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Tremor Count

**S3 — Full Bloom** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Tremor + Sinking)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Tremor + Sinking) on target (max 2); [On Use] Deal +1% damage for every Faint Aroma on target
- Inflict 1 Faint Aroma; [On Hit] Inflict +3 Sinking Count

*↳ Alternate S3 — Magnificent End* (BP 12, CP +7): rolls — low 12, high 19 (High).
  - Deal +30% damage for every excess Atk Weight beyond the number of actual targets (in Focused Encounters, the Part)
  - Final Power +1 for every 5 (sum of Faint Aroma on all targets) (max 6)
  - Lose all Petals on self
  - Inflict 5 Faint Aroma

Combat passive — **A Void that Cannot be Filled**: Always Active: Begin Encounters with 6 Bullet — Solitude.
  - At 1+ Bullet — Solitude, if the enemy has less than -40 SP or is Staggered at this unit or an ally's Attack End, use 'Bang. Bang.' as an….
  - Attack End: At 0 Bullet — Solitude, use 'Stories that Never Cease' as an Unopposed Attack against the target and consume 10 SP to Reload.

Combat passive — **Unwithering Flower**: Gain 1 Petals if the enemy takes Sinking damage.
  - Gain Petals equal to Faint Aroma inflicted every time enemies gain Faint Aroma.
  - Gain 2 Petals every time Tremor Burst is triggered regardless of the unit.

Defense skill — **Counter: A.A.T.**: [Turn End] Gain 10 Petals (once per turn).
  - [Turn End] Gain 2 Fragile and 2 Attack Power Up next turn (once per turn).
team_suggestions: **Tremor** control — stacks do nothing on their own; a **Tremor Burst** raises the target's **Stagger Threshold** by its Tremor Potency. Count drops by 1 each Turn End, so build Potency and Burst inside the same window. Same-faction teammates provide additional passive synergy where available. The support passive also benefits teammates directly — consider this identity even in compositions where it is not the primary damage dealer.
- **Lobotomy E.G.O::The Sword Sharpened with Tears Rodion**: This identity's 'Spring's Genesis' inflicts Sinking — Lobotomy E.G.O::The Sword Sharpened with Tears Rodion scales off Sinking.
- **Dawn Office Rep Gregor**: 'Stigma Workshop Prosthesis' inflicts Tremor via the support passive — scales off Tremor count/potency on the target.
- **LCCB Assistant Manager Ishmael**: 'Eye for Weakness' inflicts Tremor via the support passive — scales off Tremor count/potency on the target.
